Применяется сразу, без перезапуска. Пере: Applies immediately, no restart needed. The interface, notifications and server messages are translated; the Learn section texts, the prompt guide and Assistant replies stay in Russian.
Восстановить ВСЕ параметры генерации (пр: Restore ALL generation settings (prompt, seed, references, samplers, resolution…)
Встроенная турбо-лора включена по умолча: The built-in turbo LoRA is on by default. In "Frames" mode with audio added it is skipped automatically; regular LoRAs always work.
Выберите, что переносить: модели, файлы,: Choose what to transfer: models, files, content and/or data.
Видео продолжится с тем же ракурсом, сце: The video continues with the same angle, scene and camera motion. Finished clips are merged with the source into one video automatically.
Длинное видео обрабатывается кусками с н: A long video is processed in overlapping chunks that are then blended seamlessly. Audio is regenerated along with the video — the "Keep original audio" checkbox below uses the source track instead.
Дорожка исходника подаётся модели как га: The source audio track is fed to the model as a guide across the whole video: the speaker's facial movement and articulation are reinforced rather than blurred by repainting. The output audio still comes from the source.
До 9 картинок — помогают сохранить персо: Up to 9 images — they keep characters and the scene consistent across all extension clips.
Как модель распределяет работу между шаг: How the model spreads work across the steps. Usually best to keep simple.
Как обрабатывать загруженные картинки. M: How uploaded images are handled. Match — faster; Max — keeps reference detail better, but slower.
Как обрабатывать картинки-референсы. Mat: How reference images are handled. Match — faster; Max — keeps detail better, but slower.
Как часто очищать видеопамять во время о: How often VRAM is cleared during processing. Lower values reduce the chance of running out of memory, but are slower.
The canvas H3 redraws the face on. 512 is about 2.25× cheaper than 768 in latent tokens; above 768 VRAM and time grow sharply (engine maximum is 1344).
Картинки, сохранённые в видео при генера: Images stored with the video at generation time, plus its first frame — they keep characters, colours and lighting consistent.
Клип из монтажки — результат вернётся и: A clip from Montage — the result will come back and replace it
Лица не видно (человек спиной, в капюшон: The face is not visible (person turned away, hooded) — the head is taken from the person's box. Without this, such frames get interpolated.
Максимум 9 картинок-рефов для продления: At most 9 reference images for extension
Правило выбора субъекта. Он выбирается О: Subject selection rule. It runs ONCE per shot; afterwards the tracker keeps the same face.
Размер кусочков, на которые делится кадр: Size of the tiles a frame is split into during processing. How many are needed is calculated automatically.
Секунда переводится в ближайшее валидное: The second is converted to the nearest valid model frame count; out of range it snaps to the bound
Сколько шагов делает модель, дорисовывая: How many steps the model takes while painting the clip. More is more accurate but slower. Default is auto: the source's first-pass steps (from its metadata); a manual value overrides auto.
Сколько шагов делает финальный проход де: How many steps the final detail pass takes. More means a sharper image but longer.
Своя модель задаётся путём в поле ниже;: A custom model is set by path in the field below; picking a built-in model in the list switches back (the path is kept).
Способ, которым модель рисует кадры на ф: The algorithm the model uses for the final pass. If unsure, keep euler.
Способ, которым модель рисует кадры. Вли: The algorithm the model uses to draw frames. Affects detail and stability; if unsure, keep euler.
Тайлы согласуются после каждого шага сэм: Tiles are reconciled after every sampling step (blended into one canvas with shared noise) — this removes flicker at the seams. Turn it off to compare with the old mode.
Удалить файлы модели с диска: Delete the model files from disk
Фактическая лестница сигм (старт → … → 0: The actual sigma ladder (start → … → 0) the sampler receives. The Pass 2 preset repeats the second pass sigmas of the two-pass generation.
Что вклеивается обратно: только прямоуго: What gets pasted back: only the face rectangle or the whole crop (with hair and background — it may leave a visible rectangle).
Что делать с кадрами, где лицо не найден: What to do with frames where no face was found (turned away, covered).
Шаги сэмплирования. Наша модель 4-шагова: Sampling steps. Our model is a 4-step model — that is how many it needs.
